_note: v2.4 plan 02 step 2, row 'chat delete and a failed group delete' (H10-H11; scenario plan02 'chat-delete-reap'). No backend. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v24-02-chat-delete-reap.json --sandbox --group 1759606632088. Host facts re-verified 2026-09-24. H10: a SOLO chat delete emits CHAT_DELETED(name without .jsonl) after a 2xx (delChat script.js:1338-1356, emit :1354; deleteCharacterChatByName :1364-1402, emit :1401; character delete :10882-10884); this fixture runs in a group, so it exercises the group twin instead: deleteGroupChat (group-chats.js:2279-2310) splices the id out of group.chats BEFORE the request, and emits GROUP_CHAT_DELETED(chatId) only when the delete answered ok (:2308). H11: deleteGroup (a whole group, group-chats.js:1323-1337) emits GROUP_CHAT_DELETED for every chat BEFORE it checks response.ok, so the event alone does not prove a chat is gone. Deleting the shared test group is out of the question, so the H11 half emits that event by hand for a chat that still exists, which is exactly the shape a failed deleteGroup leaves. Flow: a second sandbox chat B is created (/newchat, adopted), plays one consumed line with a relationship memory so the mirror makes B's own book; the page returns to the first sandbox chat. H11 control: GROUP_CHAT_DELETED(B) while B still exists -> no reap offered and the book kept (expected green today and after; mutation check 10). H10: B really deleted -> within 8 s a confirm naming B's book must be offered (plan 02 section 6: absence confirmed, marker names B, then the player is asked); the fixture declines it and the book must still exist (never automatic). EXPECTED RED on today's code at the offer step: CHAT_DELETED/GROUP_CHAT_DELETED are typed [] and unsubscribed (stHost/events.ts:11-12), so nothing is offered. The solo CHAT_DELETED path is not driven here (the sandbox is group-only); it needs a solo sandbox. B's book is recorded while B is open and deleted by the sandbox mirror-book cleanup (B is an owned chat).

'').find((text) => text.includes(chatB) || text.includes(book)) ?? null; if (!ctx.groups.find((g) => g.id === ctx.groupId)?.chats.includes(chatB)) throw new Error('chat B is not listed, so this is not the failed-delete shape'); await ctx.eventSource.emit(ctx.eventTypes.GROUP_CHAT_DELETED, chatB); let offer = null; for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !offer; i += 1) { offer = offered(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (offer) { document.querySelector('dialog[open] .popup-button-cancel')?.click(); throw new Error(`a reap was offered for a chat that still exists (H11: the event is emitted before the delete is checked): ${offer.slice(0, 200)}`); } await ctx.updateWorldInfoList?.(); if (!ctx.getWorldInfoNames().includes(book)) throw new Error(`${book} was deleted on an event alone, with chat B still on disk (H11)`); return { h11: 'no offer, book kept' };
